computer_v2.onnx
SHA-256: 5e8157e8a0b2bbf4708452ccf8d0dc3397b6e81fba4dad097a8ba9192894ab3a

This file is computer_v2.onnx from the Home Assistant Wake Word Collection
by Florian Wartner, path en/computer/computer_v2.onnx on the main branch.
The upstream notes say this model reacts to "Computer" and "Hey Computer".
The collection is published under the MIT License below. That license allows
this copy to be bundled with x-voice when this notice stays with the file.

Upstream training notes also credit spoken "computer" clips from the
Picovoice wake-word benchmark and Mycroft Precise community data. Those
notes describe how the model was trained. The file shipped here is the
collection's ONNX model, under the MIT license of the collection.
